00089| void OptimiserSuite::run(
00090| 	Dialect const& _dialect,
00091| 	GasMeter const* _meter,
00092| 	Object& _object,
00093| 	bool _optimizeStackAllocation,
00094| 	string_view _optimisationSequence,
00095| 	optional<size_t> _expectedExecutionsPerDeployment,
00096| 	set<YulString> const& _externallyUsedIdentifiers
00097| )
00098| {
00099| 	EVMDialect const* evmDialect = dynamic_cast<EVMDialect const*>(&_dialect);
00100| 	bool usesOptimizedCodeGenerator =
00101| 		_optimizeStackAllocation &&
00102| 		evmDialect &&
00103| 		evmDialect->evmVersion().canOverchargeGasForCall() &&
00104| 		evmDialect->providesObjectAccess();
00105| 	set<YulString> reservedIdentifiers = _externallyUsedIdentifiers;
00106| 	reservedIdentifiers += _dialect.fixedFunctionNames();
00107| 
00108| 	*_object.code = std::get<Block>(Disambiguator(
00109| 		_dialect,
00110| 		*_object.analysisInfo,
00111| 		reservedIdentifiers
00112| 	)(*_object.code));
00113| 	Block& ast = *_object.code;
00114| 
00115| 	NameDispenser dispenser{_dialect, ast, reservedIdentifiers};
00116| 	OptimiserStepContext context{_dialect, dispenser, reservedIdentifiers, _expectedExecutionsPerDeployment};
00117| 
00118| 	OptimiserSuite suite(context, Debug::None);
00119| 
00120| 	// Some steps depend on properties ensured by FunctionHoister, BlockFlattener, FunctionGrouper and
00121| 	// ForLoopInitRewriter. Run them first to be able to run arbitrary sequences safely.
00122| 	suite.runSequence("hgfo", ast);
00123| 
00124| 	NameSimplifier::run(suite.m_context, ast);
00125| 	// Now the user-supplied part
00126| 	suite.runSequence(_optimisationSequence, ast);
00127| 
00128| 	// This is a tuning parameter, but actually just prevents infinite loops.
00129| 	size_t stackCompressorMaxIterations = 16;
00130| 	suite.runSequence("g", ast);
00131| 
00132| 	// We ignore the return value because we will get a much better error
00133| 	// message once we perform code generation.
00134| 	if (!usesOptimizedCodeGenerator)
00135| 		StackCompressor::run(
00136| 			_dialect,
00137| 			_object,
00138| 			_optimizeStackAllocation,
00139| 			stackCompressorMaxIterations
00140| 		);
00141| 	suite.runSequence("fDnTOc g", ast);
00142| 
00143| 	if (evmDialect)
00144| 	{
00145| 		yulAssert(_meter, "");
00146| 		ConstantOptimiser{*evmDialect, *_meter}(ast);
00147| 		if (usesOptimizedCodeGenerator)
00148| 		{
00149| 			StackCompressor::run(
00150| 				_dialect,
00151| 				_object,
00152| 				_optimizeStackAllocation,
00153| 				stackCompressorMaxIterations
00154| 			);
00155| 			if (evmDialect->providesObjectAccess())
00156| 				StackLimitEvader::run(suite.m_context, _object);
00157| 		}
00158| 		else if (evmDialect->providesObjectAccess() && _optimizeStackAllocation)
00159| 			StackLimitEvader::run(suite.m_context, _object);
00160| 	}
00161| 	else if (dynamic_cast<WasmDialect const*>(&_dialect))
00162| 	{
00163| 		// If the first statement is an empty block, remove it.
00164| 		// We should only have function definitions after that.
00165| 		if (ast.statements.size() > 1 && std::get<Block>(ast.statements.front()).statements.empty())
00166| 			ast.statements.erase(ast.statements.begin());
00167| 	}
00168| 
00169| 	dispenser.reset(ast);
00170| 	NameSimplifier::run(suite.m_context, ast);
00171| 	VarNameCleaner::run(suite.m_context, ast);
00172| 
00173| 	*_object.analysisInfo = AsmAnalyzer::analyzeStrictAssertCorrect(_dialect, _object);
00174| }

00293| void OptimiserSuite::validateSequence(string_view _stepAbbreviations)
00294| {
00295| 	int8_t nestingLevel = 0;
00296| 	for (char abbreviation: _stepAbbreviations)
00297| 		switch (abbreviation)
00298| 		{
00299| 		case ' ':
00300| 		case '\n':
00301| 			break;
00302| 		case '[':
00303| 			assertThrow(nestingLevel < numeric_limits<int8_t>::max(), OptimizerException, "Brackets nested too deep");
00304| 			nestingLevel++;
00305| 			break;
00306| 		case ']':
00307| 			nestingLevel--;
00308| 			assertThrow(nestingLevel >= 0, OptimizerException, "Unbalanced brackets");
00309| 			break;
00310| 		default:
00311| 		{
00312| 			yulAssert(
00313| 				string(NonStepAbbreviations).find(abbreviation) == string::npos,
00314| 				"Unhandled syntactic element in the abbreviation sequence"
00315| 			);
00316| 			assertThrow(
00317| 				stepAbbreviationToNameMap().find(abbreviation) != stepAbbreviationToNameMap().end(),
00318| 				OptimizerException,
00319| 				"'"s + abbreviation + "' is not a valid step abbreviation"
00320| 			);
00321| 			optional<string> invalid = allSteps().at(stepAbbreviationToNameMap().at(abbreviation))->invalidInCurrentEnvironment();
00322| 			assertThrow(
00323| 				!invalid.has_value(),
00324| 				OptimizerException,
00325| 				"'"s + abbreviation + "' is invalid in the current environment: " + *invalid
00326| 			);
00327| 		}
00328| 		}
00329| 	assertThrow(nestingLevel == 0, OptimizerException, "Unbalanced brackets");
00330| }

00332| void OptimiserSuite::runSequence(string_view _stepAbbreviations, Block& _ast, bool _repeatUntilStable)
00333| {
00334| 	validateSequence(_stepAbbreviations);
00335| 
00336| 	// This splits 'aaa[bbb]ccc...' into 'aaa' and '[bbb]ccc...'.
00337| 	auto extractNonNestedPrefix = [](string_view _tail) -> tuple<string_view, string_view>
00338| 	{
00339| 		for (size_t i = 0; i < _tail.size(); ++i)
00340| 		{
00341| 			yulAssert(_tail[i] != ']');
00342| 			if (_tail[i] == '[')
00343| 				return {_tail.substr(0, i), _tail.substr(i)};
00344| 		}
00345| 		return {_tail, {}};
00346| 	};
00347| 
00348| 	// This splits '[bbb]ccc...' into 'bbb' and 'ccc...'.
00349| 	auto extractBracketContent = [](string_view _tail) -> tuple<string_view, string_view>
00350| 	{
00351| 		yulAssert(!_tail.empty() && _tail[0] == '[');
00352| 
00353| 		size_t contentLength = 0;
00354| 		int8_t nestingLevel = 1;
00355| 		for (char abbreviation: _tail.substr(1))
00356| 		{
00357| 			if (abbreviation == '[')
00358| 			{
00359| 				yulAssert(nestingLevel < numeric_limits<int8_t>::max());
00360| 				++nestingLevel;
00361| 			}
00362| 			else if (abbreviation == ']')
00363| 			{
00364| 				--nestingLevel;
00365| 				if (nestingLevel == 0)
00366| 					break;
00367| 			}
00368| 			++contentLength;
00369| 		}
00370| 		yulAssert(nestingLevel == 0);
00371| 		yulAssert(_tail[contentLength + 1] == ']');
00372| 
00373| 		return {_tail.substr(1, contentLength), _tail.substr(contentLength + 2)};
00374| 	};
00375| 
00376| 	auto abbreviationsToSteps = [](string_view _sequence) -> vector<string>
00377| 	{
00378| 		vector<string> steps;
00379| 		for (char abbreviation: _sequence)
00380| 			if (abbreviation != ' ' && abbreviation != '\n')
00381| 				steps.emplace_back(stepAbbreviationToNameMap().at(abbreviation));
00382| 		return steps;
00383| 	};
00384| 
00385| 	vector<tuple<string_view, bool>> subsequences;
00386| 	string_view tail = _stepAbbreviations;
00387| 	while (!tail.empty())
00388| 	{
00389| 		string_view subsequence;
00390| 		tie(subsequence, tail) = extractNonNestedPrefix(tail);
00391| 		if (subsequence.size() > 0)
00392| 			subsequences.push_back({subsequence, false});
00393| 
00394| 		if (tail.empty())
00395| 			break;
00396| 
00397| 		tie(subsequence, tail) = extractBracketContent(tail);
00398| 		if (subsequence.size() > 0)
00399| 			subsequences.push_back({subsequence, true});
00400| 	}
00401| 
00402| 	size_t codeSize = 0;
00403| 	for (size_t round = 0; round < MaxRounds; ++round)
00404| 	{
00405| 		for (auto const& [subsequence, repeat]: subsequences)
00406| 		{
00407| 			if (repeat)
00408| 				runSequence(subsequence, _ast, true);
00409| 			else
00410| 				runSequence(abbreviationsToSteps(subsequence), _ast);
00411| 		}
00412| 
00413| 		if (!_repeatUntilStable)
00414| 			break;
00415| 
00416| 		size_t newSize = CodeSize::codeSizeIncludingFunctions(_ast);
00417| 		if (newSize == codeSize)
00418| 			break;
00419| 		codeSize = newSize;
00420| 	}
00421| }

00044|  * Optimiser suite that combines all steps and also provides the settings for the heuristics.
00045|  * Only optimizes the code of the provided object, does not descend into the sub-objects.
00046|  */
00047| class OptimiserSuite
00048| {
00049| public:
00050| 	static constexpr size_t MaxRounds = 12;
00051| 
00052| 	/// Special characters that do not represent optimiser steps but are allowed in abbreviation sequences.
00053| 	/// Some of them (like whitespace) are ignored, others (like brackets) are a part of the syntax.
00054| 	static constexpr char NonStepAbbreviations[] = " \n[]";
00055| 
00056| 	enum class Debug
00057| 	{
00058| 		None,
00059| 		PrintStep,
00060| 		PrintChanges
00061| 	};
00062| 	OptimiserSuite(OptimiserStepContext& _context, Debug _debug = Debug::None): m_context(_context), m_debug(_debug) {}
00063| 
00064| 	/// The value nullopt for `_expectedExecutionsPerDeployment` represents creation code.
00065| 	static void run(
00066| 		Dialect const& _dialect,
00067| 		GasMeter const* _meter,
00068| 		Object& _object,
00069| 		bool _optimizeStackAllocation,

00294| {
00295| 	int8_t nestingLevel = 0;
00296| 	for (char abbreviation: _stepAbbreviations)

00305| 			break;
00306| 		case ']':

00311| 		{
00312| 			yulAssert(
00313| 				string(NonStepAbbreviations).find(abbreviation) == string::npos,
00314| 				"Unhandled syntactic element in the abbreviation sequence"
00315| 			);

00318| 				OptimizerException,

00320| 			);

00325| 				"'"s + abbreviation + "' is invalid in the current environment: " + *invalid

00333| {
00334| 	validateSequence(_stepAbbreviations);
00335| 
00336| 	// This splits 'aaa[bbb]ccc...' into 'aaa' and '[bbb]ccc...'.
00337| 	auto extractNonNestedPrefix = [](string_view _tail) -> tuple<string_view, string_view>
00338| 	{
00339| 		for (size_t i = 0; i < _tail.size(); ++i)
00340| 		{
00341| 			yulAssert(_tail[i] != ']');
00342| 			if (_tail[i] == '[')
00343| 				return {_tail.substr(0, i), _tail.substr(i)};
00344| 		}
00345| 		return {_tail, {}};
00346| 	};
00347| 
00348| 	// This splits '[bbb]ccc...' into 'bbb' and 'ccc...'.
00349| 	auto extractBracketContent = [](string_view _tail) -> tuple<string_view, string_view>
00350| 	{
00351| 		yulAssert(!_tail.empty() && _tail[0] == '[');
00352| 
00353| 		size_t contentLength = 0;
00354| 		int8_t nestingLevel = 1;
00355| 		for (char abbreviation: _tail.substr(1))
00356| 		{
00357| 			if (abbreviation == '[')
00358| 			{
00359| 				yulAssert(nestingLevel < numeric_limits<int8_t>::max());
00360| 				++nestingLevel;
00361| 			}
00362| 			else if (abbreviation == ']')
00363| 			{
00364| 				--nestingLevel;
00365| 				if (nestingLevel == 0)
00366| 					break;
00367| 			}
00368| 			++contentLength;
00369| 		}
00370| 		yulAssert(nestingLevel == 0);
00371| 		yulAssert(_tail[contentLength + 1] == ']');
00372| 
00373| 		return {_tail.substr(1, contentLength), _tail.substr(contentLength + 2)};
00374| 	};
00375| 
00376| 	auto abbreviationsToSteps = [](string_view _sequence) -> vector<string>
00377| 	{
00378| 		vector<string> steps;
00379| 		for (char abbreviation: _sequence)
00380| 			if (abbreviation != ' ' && abbreviation != '\n')
00381| 				steps.emplace_back(stepAbbreviationToNameMap().at(abbreviation));
00382| 		return steps;
00383| 	};
00384| 
00385| 	vector<tuple<string_view, bool>> subsequences;
00386| 	string_view tail = _stepAbbreviations;
00387| 	while (!tail.empty())
00388| 	{
00389| 		string_view subsequence;
00390| 		tie(subsequence, tail) = extractNonNestedPrefix(tail);
00391| 		if (subsequence.size() > 0)
00392| 			subsequences.push_back({subsequence, false});
00393| 
00394| 		if (tail.empty())
00395| 			break;
00396| 
00397| 		tie(subsequence, tail) = extractBracketContent(tail);
00398| 		if (subsequence.size() > 0)
00399| 			subsequences.push_back({subsequence, true});
00400| 	}
00401| 
00402| 	size_t codeSize = 0;
00403| 	for (size_t round = 0; round < MaxRounds; ++round)
00404| 	{
00405| 		for (auto const& [subsequence, repeat]: subsequences)
00406| 		{
00407| 			if (repeat)
00408| 				runSequence(subsequence, _ast, true);
00409| 			else
00410| 				runSequence(abbreviationsToSteps(subsequence), _ast);
00411| 		}
00412| 
00413| 		if (!_repeatUntilStable)
00414| 			break;
00415| 
00416| 		size_t newSize = CodeSize::codeSizeIncludingFunctions(_ast);
00417| 		if (newSize == codeSize)
00418| 			break;
00419| 		codeSize = newSize;
00420| 	}
00421| }

summary.title: Control methods: pros and cons in three sentences

parts.text: 不同控制方式的优劣是什么？三句话简述

三种控制方式对比：

1. **静态全局变量** - 最简单，但线程不安全，难以动态切换
2. **命令行参数** - 用户友好，可灵活控制，但需修改参数解析和传递链
3. **环境变量** - 无需修改接口，适合试验性开关，但不够显式且难以发现

你倾向哪种？还是组合使用？
环境变量吧，但是我希望改动尽可能少，越少越好
